query:
SELECT
				id as "id!: Uuid",
				channel_id as "channel_id!: Uuid",
				content as "content!",
				profile_id as "profile_id!: Uuid",
				created_at as "created_at!: time::OffsetDateTime"
			FROM (
				SELECT
					id, channel_id, profile_id, content, created_at
				FROM
					messages
				WHERE
					channel_id = ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR id < ?2)
				ORDER BY
					id DESC
				LIMIT
					?3
			)
			ORDER BY id ASC
